website.note: Confirms two flagship product candidates (AVIM Therapy, Virtue SAB)

ctgov.note: Pivotal device studies are sponsored on ClinicalTrials.gov by partner/affiliate entities (BackBeat Medical for BACKBEAT; Caliber Therapeutics/Orchestra for Virtue Trial), so sponsor query returned no rows. NCTs identified via web search and confirmed: NCT06059638 (BACKBEAT), NCT07045194 (Virtue Trial).

pipeline.modality: Bioelectronic therapy delivered via standard dual-chamber cardiac pacemaker (proprietary firmware/algorithm); partnered with Medtronic
pipeline.target: Atrioventricular interval modulation to acutely lower systolic blood pressure
pipeline.license_origin: Internal (BackBeat Medical, LLC, wholly-owned subsidiary); exclusive global development & commercialization license/collaboration with Medtronic (Jun 2022; amended Aug 2025 to add a leadless dual-chamber pacemaker integration framework)

indications.indication: Uncontrolled hypertension in patients indicated for a Medtronic dual-chamber cardiac pacemaker despite anti-hypertensive medications
indications.trial_design: Global, multi-center, prospective, randomized 1:1, double-blind pivotal IDE study; enrolling up to ~500 patients; AVIM therapy + medical therapy vs. medical therapy + standard pacing
indications.trial_status: RECRUITING — first patient randomized late Dec 2023; enrollment completion currently planned for mid-2026
indications.lead_sponsor: BackBeat Medical, LLC (Orchestra BioMed wholly-owned subsidiary); Medtronic collaboration
key_milestones: Jun 2022: Exclusive license & collaboration agreement with Medtronic
Dec 2023: First patient randomized in BACKBEAT pivotal study
Aug 2025: Medtronic Agreement amendment adding dual-chamber leadless pacemaker integration framework

pipeline.modality: Non-coated micro-porous angioplasty balloon delivering proprietary extended-release sirolimus (SirolimusEFR) into the arterial wall
pipeline.target: Local anti-proliferative (mTOR inhibition) at coronary lesion site
pipeline.license_origin: Internal (Caliber Therapeutics, LLC, wholly-owned subsidiary). Prior Terumo collaboration terminated Oct 28, 2025; Terumo retains a right of first refusal for Virtue SAB in coronary artery disease.

indications.trial_name: Virtue Trial (Virtue SAB in the Treatment of Coronary ISR)
indications.trial_design: Prospective, multi-center, single-blind, randomized 1:1, non-inferiority pivotal IDE study; up to 740 patients across ~75 US centers; head-to-head vs. Boston Scientific AGENT paclitaxel drug-coated balloon; primary endpoint = Target Lesion Failure (composite of cardiac death, nonfatal target-vessel MI, ischemia-driven target lesion revascularization) at 12 months
indications.trial_status: RECRUITING — first patients enrolled Oct 27, 2025; enrollment completion planned for mid-2027
key_milestones: Aug 2023: Initial FDA IDE approval for coronary ISR pivotal
Apr 2025: FDA approval of revised IDE for head-to-head vs. AGENT DCB

commercial_product.name: FreeHold Duo / FreeHold Trio intracorporeal organ retractors
commercial_product.description: Intracorporeal organ retractors sold by FreeHold Surgical, LLC (Orchestra BioMed subsidiary)

excluded_preclinical: Virtue SAB for de novo coronary small vessel disease (Breakthrough Device Designation; no active pivotal trial yet — 10-K notes plan to leverage data; not yet in active pivotal study)
Virtue SAB for below-the-knee infrapopliteal peripheral artery disease (Breakthrough Device Designation; no active pivotal trial yet)
AVIM-therapy integration into Medtronic dual-chamber leadless pacemaker (development framework only)
excluded_legacy_terminated: Terumo Agreement for Virtue SAB (terminated Oct 28, 2025; superseded by Termination & ROFR Agreement)
